causalAutopsy.notes: The notifier was designed Telegram-first: 'lifelineTopic' is a Telegram concept and was the only destination resolver for unbound notices. Slack support arrived later as a separate adapter with its own attention channel, and the notifier was never taught about it. Latent for every Slack-only agent since Slack support landed; it surfaced only because indra's dropped notices were read directly out of its reap records.

classClosure.reason: No self-triggered loop added. The change runs inside the existing flush on a branch that was previously a drop; the one action added is a single attention item on a fixed id.
